# Quick scan all raw SNVs annotate nonsense, no depth filter, print all nonsense with dp/alt
import gzip, pysam
transcripts={}
gene_info={}
with gzip.open('ann/gencode.v47.annotation.gtf.gz','rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('#'): continue
        p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        if len(p)<9 or p[2]"'!='"'CDS': continue
        attrs=p[8]; d={}
        for x in attrs.split(';'):
            x=x.strip()
            if not x: continue
            kv=x.split(' ',1) if ' ' in x else x.split('=')
            if len(kv)==2: d[kv[0]]=kv[1].strip().strip('\"')
        tid=d.get('transcript_id'); gid=d.get('gene_id')
        if not tid: continue
        gene_info[gid]=d.get('gene_name')
        transcripts.setdefault(tid,{'strand':p[6],'gene_id':gid,'exons':[]})['exons'].append((int(p[3]),int(p[4])))
fa=pysam.FastaFile('ref/chr9.fa')
comp=str.maketrans('ACGTN','TGCAN')
def rc(s): return s.translate(comp)[::-1]
cmaps={}
for tid,t in transcripts.items():
    strand=t['strand']; ex=t['exons']
    if strand=='+':
        exs=sorted(ex); pos=[]; 
        for s,e in exs: pos += list(range(s,e+1))
        seq=''.join(fa.fetch('chr9',x-1,x).upper() for x in pos)
    else:
        exs=sorted(ex,reverse=True); pos=[]
        for s,e in exs: pos += list(range(e,s-1,-1))
        seq=''.join(rc(fa.fetch('chr9',x-1,x).upper()) for x in pos)
